page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Below the text: catchword at the right and gathering signature at the centre. No marginal notes.

l.i: Prope Arnhemum Geldriæ Oppidum, Clabequii prope Bruxellam Cry-
stallos duriores, sive Pseudo-adamantes reperiri scribit Ansb: Boët: de
Boot: de Lapid: & Genr. L.II.C.73.p.217. Et Kunkel de Art: Vitr: P. II.
In Helvetia nostra vix esse montem excelsiorem Crystallis vacu-
um jam supra attigi. Præ aliis tamen locis memoratur à Celeberr: D.
D. Wagnero Helvet: Curios: p.325. Apud subsylvanos Mons,
dictus, Parochiæ Saxlensis, Crystalli ferax. Apud Glaronenses, Mons
dictus, prope Wichlam pagum, & Mons,
dictus, in valle
Crazera, apud Lepontios in Grinsula, Gotthardo, Furca, apud Rhætos in valle
Ætuatia, valle Massinensi, Monte rubro, qui est in inferiore Engadina &c. In
Valesia prope Gasam &c. Et jam supra laudatus Exc: D. D. Muralt: Act:
Philosoph: Transact. A.1669.p.250. Prope Valesiam & Augustam, in Nomar-
chia Bernensi, prope Taminium & Tavetsch, Rhætorum, Item in montis Gott-
hardi ascensu, Item montibus prope Valesiam, Urselen [?], prope montem schelli-
nin. Inveni & ego in Monte Crispalto Rhetiæ, in Valesiæ omnibus fere ju-
gis, præsertim

In Germaniæ provinciis pluribus, præsertim Bohemia, Hungaria, Sa-

Boët: de Boot: L.C. In Moravia prope Iglaviam, in montibus

page.notes: Page number printed at the head as "(43)" with ornaments on either side. Catchword "In" and signature "F 2" as printed. Doubtful readings: "Urselen" (marked [?]); "Leiterberg" and "Tractis" are read from a blurred scan and are not marked, though the first may read "Lei-terberg". Black letter (German names) marked with bl. Line-end hyphens in "ju-gis", "schelli-nin", "Wincen-burgensi" and "Lei-terberg" are as printed.
